## Use this when

- escape vendor lock-in
- migrate from no-code
- export an AI-built app
- audit app portability

## Problem

A founder or operator needs a clear portability, dependency, security and migration map for an app tied to a builder-specific runtime.

## Inputs

Authorized read-only project access or exported source/schema information.

## Outputs

Dependency map, route/schema inventory, security findings, provider-neutral architecture candidate, reconstruction manifest and migration/rollback plan.

## Pricing

$500 one-time.

- App Escape Audit: $500 (one_time)

## Invocation and authority

LIVE fixed-price human review handoff through the central Machine Commerce MCP tool prepare_quote_ready_service_handoff. Discovery and qualification are machine-callable; source access, payment and paid work remain explicitly human-confirmed.

Explicit buyer authorization for source access and payment is required.

Payment authority: Evercraft Payments; direct machine checkout is not exposed for this service.

Discovery does not create a payment obligation. Human confirmation is required before checkout where checkout exists. Checkout creation is not proof of payment.
